title: Decoded StarSight electronic program guide

channels.description: Every channel the listings refer to, from the channel field of the Show List commands.

id.description: Identifies a channel. Referenced by listings[].channel. From the low 15 bits of bytes 4-5 of a Show List command. It names a position in a line-up rather than a station, so several ids can carry one station and show identical listings.

callSign.description: The station's call letters, up to four. From bytes 8-15 of a Channel Data command, selected by the presence mask in byte 7. Absent unless a Channel Data command was captured, which none so far has been.

channelNumber.description: The position the channel is tuned at, 9 bits. From byte 6 of a Channel Data command with its top bit in byte 3. Absent unless a Channel Data command was captured.

showsCallSign.description: The receiver should show the call sign rather than the channel number. From bit 1 of byte 5 of a Channel Data command. Omitted when false.

displayName.description: The channel's name. From a Channel Data command. Absent unless one was captured, which none so far has been.

themes.description: Every theme the programs refer to, from the theme field of the Show Title commands.

id.description: Identifies a genre and subgenre together. Referenced by programs[].theme. From bytes 5-6 of a Show Title command.

name.description: The genre's label. From the NUL-terminated name in a Theme Category or Theme Sub-Category entry - the only strings in the format that are not compressed. Absent unless one of those commands was captured, which none so far has been.

id.description: Identifies a program. Referenced by listings[].program. From bytes 3-4 of a Show Title command, or bytes 2-3 of a Show List slot. Reused between seasons, so one id names different programs in captures months apart.

title.description: The program's name. From the compressed text at the end of a Show Title command. Absent when no Show Title for this id was captured.

theme.description: The program's genre. References themes[].id. From bytes 5-6 of the same Show Title command that carried the title, so it is absent exactly when the title is.

closedCaptioned.description: The program is closed captioned. From bit 6 of byte 2 of a Show Title command. Omitted when false.

stereo.description: The program is broadcast in stereo. From bit 5 of byte 2 of a Show Title command. Omitted when false.

blackAndWhite.description: The program is in black and white. From bit 4 of byte 2 of a Show Title command. Omitted when false.

programs.description: One entry per distinct show id, built from the Show Title commands and from the show ids the listings refer to.

descriptions.description: Synopses, from the Show Description commands. Numbered independently of the programs and reached through listings[].description.

id.description: Identifies a description. Referenced by listings[].description. From bytes 3-4 of a Show Description command. Not a show id: the two numberings are separate spaces.

text.description: The synopsis itself. From the compressed text at the end of a Show Description command.

year.description: The year the program was made. From byte 9 of a Show Description command, which carries the last two digits and is present only on the extended form that bit 3 of the flag byte selects.

ratingSystem.description: Which rating scheme the rating belongs to. Qualifies descriptions[].rating. From the top three bits of byte 7 of a Show Description command, on the extended form only.

rating.description: How the program is rated within ratingSystem. From bits 4-1 of byte 7 of a Show Description command, on the extended form only. Left as the broadcast number because one code means different things in different systems; where a rating has a printable name it already begins the text.

advisories.description: What the rating warns about. Qualifies descriptions[].rating. From the bits of byte 8 of a Show Description command, on the extended form only. Omitted when none is set.

listings.description: The schedule: one entry per slot of the Show List commands, each naming its channel and program by id.

channel.description: Which channel the program is on. References channels[].id. From bytes 4-5 of the Show List command this slot belongs to.

start.description: When the slot begins, GMT. From the Show List command's start time in bytes 6-9, advanced by the durations of the slots before this one; a slot itself carries only its length.

durationMinutes.description: How long the slot runs, in whole minutes. From byte 1 of the slot.

program.description: Which program is on. References programs[].id. From bytes 2-3 of the slot. The entry it names may have no title, meaning no Show Title for it was captured.

description.description: The synopsis to show with this program. References descriptions[].id. From the two optional bytes that bit 7 of the slot flags selects. Usually dangles: no capture so far carries both a schedule and the descriptions its slots point at.

showGroup.description: Groups this slot with others, on a basis not yet known. From the two optional bytes that bit 5 of the slot flags selects. Has appeared once in 43,430 slots.

payPerView.description: The program must be bought to watch. From bit 6 of the slot flag byte. Omitted when false.

joinedInProgress.description: The program was already running when the list began, so this slot is a placeholder rather than a showing. From bit 0 of the flag byte of a list's first slot. Omitted when false.

slotFlags.description: The slot's flag byte as broadcast. From byte 0 of the slot. Kept whole so the four bits no field above names are not lost.

clock.description: The station clock, from the Time commands, sent about twice a minute.

time.description: The instant the station was broadcasting, GMT. From bytes 2-5 of a Time command as minutes since 1992-01-01, plus seconds in byte 7.

utcOffsetMinutes.description: The station's standard offset from GMT, in minutes. From bits 0-3 of byte 6 of a Time command as whole hours, made negative by bit 4.

daylightSaving.description: The station's wall clock is an hour ahead of utcOffsetMinutes. From bit 7 of byte 6 of a Time command.

daylightSavingChanges.description: When the station moves its clock, from the Daylight Saving Change commands. The same pair is repeated unchanged, so it usually appears many times.

starts.description: When daylight saving begins, GMT. From bytes 2-5 of a Daylight Saving Change command.

ends.description: When daylight saving ends, GMT. From bytes 6-9 of the same command.

sequenceNumbers.description: Numbers the packets, one per packet, so a gap is a packet that never arrived. From bytes 2-5 of the Sequence Number commands, in the order received. Count loss from consecutive steps rather than from the span, since a flipped bit can move one value by up to 2^31.

description: One StarSight electronic program guide. Six tables of what the broadcast carried: channels, themes, programs and descriptions are referenced by the listings that make up the schedule, while the clock, daylight saving and sequence tables stand on their own. Every value comes from a command in the StarSight packet stream carried on a line of the NTSC vertical blanking interval; nothing here describes the decode itself. Times are GMT and ids are as broadcast. Byte layouts are in docs/starsight.md.
